model_annotation:
The two plots illustrate the training rewards for different models on easy and hard training sets over a range of steps. Both plots share the same x-axis and y-axis labels, with the x-axis representing "Steps" and the y-axis representing "Training Rewards". The x-axis is linear, ranging from 0 to 500 with a tick label interval of 100, while the y-axis is also linear, with a range of 0.0 to 0.4 for the top plot and 0.0 to 0.2 for the bottom plot, and tick label intervals of 0.2 and 0.1, respectively.

The top plot, labeled "Easy Training Set", compares the training rewards of two models: Llama-On-Policy-Easy and Llama-LUFFY-Easy. Llama-On-Policy-Easy is represented by a blue solid line, starting at approximately 0.0 at 0 steps and increasing to around 0.3 at 500 steps, with some fluctuations. Llama-LUFFY-Easy is represented by a red solid line, starting at approximately 0.0 at 0 steps and increasing to around 0.35 at 500 steps, also with some fluctuations. Both lines exhibit a generally increasing trend, with Llama-LUFFY-Easy showing a slightly higher training reward towards the end.

The bottom plot, labeled "Hard Training Set", compares the training rewards of two models: Llama-On-Policy-Hard and Llama-LUFFY-Hard. Llama-On-Policy-Hard is represented by a blue solid line, starting at approximately 0.0 at 0 steps and decreasing to around 0.0 at 500 steps. Llama-LUFFY-Hard is represented by a red solid line, starting at approximately 0.0 at 0 steps and increasing to around 0.2 at 500 steps, with some fluctuations. Both lines exhibit distinct trends, with Llama-On-Policy-Hard showing a decline and Llama-LUFFY-Hard showing an increase.
